description: Record that a ticket waits on another ticket, a project, or an outside event (External). Add one blocker per condition that clears on its own, each with a short title. A blocker with a date says only its date condition, not the other blockers.

blocker_id.description: The ticket or project it waits on. Required for Ticket and Project.

description.description: More detail on what is awaited

due_kind.description: What the date means: wait_until (do not start before), review_on (look again then), expected_by (should clear by then). Needs due_on.

title.description: A short label the board shows, a few words. An External blocker needs this or a description.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: add_blocker
title: Add a blocker
